title: Deeper/broader DXF peer implementation-lineage and QCAD consumer boundary
scope: Read-only primary-source comparison of QCAD Community Edition, LibreDWG, ACadSharp, and ezdxf operation/version/transfer boundaries; update optional consumer readiness without claiming execution or support qualification.

sources.name: QCAD repository
sources.evidence: Identifies QCAD as an open-source 2D CAD application with DXF support and optional DWG through a proprietary plugin.
sources.limit: Repository overview does not qualify a particular build or file result.

sources.name: QCAD official feature matrix
sources.evidence: Lists QCAD CE DXF R15 read/write; broader DWG/DXF version coverage is marked for QCAD Professional and QCAD/CAM.
sources.limit: Vendor feature declaration; no local binary or drawing was executed.

sources.name: QCAD DXF module source description and license
sources.evidence: Describes DXF import/export as based on dxflib; the license inventory identifies bundled dxflib.
sources.limit: Establishes a related implementation component, not an independent format-parser vote or exact ancestry relationship to this checkout.

sources.name: LibreDWG README
sources.evidence: Separates broad DWG read scope with advanced R2010+ objects that may be skipped from write limitations; dxf2dwg is documented as R2000-only.
sources.limit: Mutable project contract; exact execution still requires immutable tool/revision/profile binding.

sources.name: ACadSharp README and issue 1195
sources.evidence: README publishes separate DXF/DWG reader/writer version columns, including no AC1021 DWG writer. Issue 1195 reports silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission on DXF writing for ACadSharp 3.4.9, including solid-only blocks.
sources.limit: The issue report is release-scoped and is not a current-release retest or a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: ezdxf XREF documentation and entity model source
sources.evidence: The XREF utility documents a selected copyable/transformable subset and exclusions for ACAD_TABLE, unknown/proxy records and many HEADER/OBJECTS features; the general model notes unsupported-version features may be ignored on export.
sources.limit: Transfer utility boundaries do not describe all ezdxf parser/writer capabilities or independently qualify ACIS semantics.

findings: QCAD CE is a candidate optional AC1015 DXF application consumer, not DWG, 3D, or ACIS evidence; its Professional DWG plugin is proprietary and outside the open-source codec comparison.

A version support claim must name operation direction and exact tool: LibreDWG read/write ceilings differ, ACadSharp publishes operation-specific version rows, and DXF transfer helpers such as ezdxf XREF are narrower than general file I/O.
ACadSharp issue 1195 reinforces the need for per-source-entity output disposition and BLOCK/INSERT closure checks, but remains a version-scoped peer report rather than a local defect.
No new libdxfrw defect or support promotion was established; the existing PAR-07/S8 and S2.3.9.4.29 owners remain appropriate.
implementationReadyChecks: Keep evidence keyed by format, version/encoding, direction, entity/property, ownership/reference closure, and consumer route.
Optionally run QCAD CE only at the existing composed checkpoint with a locally generated AC1015 DXF and an exact app/build/input/output binding; record NOT_RUN when unavailable.
For modeler output compare each source handle disposition and block/insert reachability after strict reopen; do not use aggregate counts or successful document load as preservation proof.
Do not make QCAD, LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, or platform availability a per-slice implementation blocker; continue focused local fast tests and self-unblock.
